# Saygrove

> Community media sharing and messaging mobile application.
> Architected and developed by Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya).
> Developer Profile: https://github.com/krishujeniya
> Portfolio Showcase: https://mostlyoutlier.pages.dev/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/Saygrove

## Overview
Saygrove is a cross-platform mobile application developed in Flutter and Dart, supporting multimedia post feeds, threaded discussions, real-time private messaging, and community channels.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
